---
title: "Consensus proteomic meta-programs"
output: html_document
---

Study-level NMF, ICA and shared-nearest-neighbour components were filtered for
within-study stability, cross-study recurrence and redundancy before assembly
into 13 meta-programs. The input tables contain the component audit trail,
meta-program memberships and leave-one-study-out results. The script reproduces
the filtering funnel, protein catalogue and transfer summaries. It does not
repeat the participant-level matrix decompositions.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "06_meta_programs.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/06_meta_programs/meta_program_summary.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

Panel-ready outputs are written to `analysis/06_meta_programs/`.
